dedupe_keys.name: automationml iec 62714 engineering data exchange format for industrial automation with whitepapers and application recommendations

description: AutomationML is an XML-based data exchange format, standardised as IEC 62714, for exchanging engineering information between tools used to plan industrial automation and control systems,. The association AutomationML e.V. publishes the specification whitepapers (for example Part 1 on architecture and general requirements), an overview called AutomationML in a Nutshell, a joint OPC Foundation information model to represent AutomationML models in OPC UA, a whitepaper on using ECLASS catalogue semantics, and application recommendations. Coverage: generic, for manufacturing plants and automation systems. A draft application recommendation on material handling (version 0.0.1, June 2026, 84 pages) models the flow of material through a plant from sources along conveyors and stations to sinks; it is not yet published. Format and access: whitepapers and library packages (.aml files) downloadable from the specifications page; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): copyright AutomationML e.V. (legal notice: reproduction and distribution need prior permission). Caveats: the format carries plant engineering models, not operational data; the IEC edition of the standard was not read. Simulation uses: exchanging plant topology and material flow models between planning tools to build digital twins of production systems. Related records: the Asset Administration Shell and OPC UA specifications are recorded on other branches of this round.
